metadata.description: Case-person catalogue for the Karmein Chan Knowledge File.
change_summary: Migrated the five original records to the v0.2.x identity/review schema.
Restricted KCSRC00037 to geographic context on the Parer Street records.
Applied publication holds to sensitive allegations and suspect/person-of-interest records.
Moved four contextual records to a contextual_people layer.
Marked synthetic ordinal records explicitly as unresolved placeholders.
Added record_scope, verification and publication-status fields to every record.
Added Kelvin “Kel” Glare, Chief Commissioner of Victoria Police at the time of Karmein Chan’s abduction and a reported acquaintance of John Chan.
metadata.identity_handling_note: Mr Cruel, Karmein Chan’s abductor, the Parer Street stalker, the Edgars Creek armed man and the man reportedly seen digging remain separate entities linked only by unresolved hypotheses.

people.description: Victims, relatives, witnesses, investigators, specialists, alleged offenders and publicly discussed persons of interest directly represented in the case graph.

contextual_people.description: People retained for contextual comparison or background but excluded from the core case graph.

inference_score.0: directly asserted or exact structural reference
inference_score.1: editorial normalization or unresolved entity distinction
inference_score.2: explicit hypothesis; must not be stated as established fact
inference_score.3: highly speculative; prohibited from publication without exceptional corroboration

pending_global_work.description: Attach page, paragraph, timestamp, quotation or equivalent locator to each material claim.
